payload.criterion: agents/se-reviewer.md exists without Write/Edit tools and forbids store writes; sync-plugin.sh installs the agents/ directory
payload.verify_command: test -f agents/se-reviewer.md && grep -qiE "no Write|without Write" agents/se-reviewer.md && grep -q agents/ scripts/sync-plugin.sh && d=$(mktemp -d) && bash scripts/sync-plugin.sh "$d/p" && test -f "$d/p/agents/se-reviewer.md"
